# FLOAT16_LN10

> [Natural logarithm][@stdlib/math/base/special/ln] of `10` as a half-precision floating-point number.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var FLOAT16_LN10 = require( '@stdlib/constants/float16/ln-ten' );
```

#### FLOAT16_LN10

[Natural logarithm][@stdlib/math/base/special/ln] of `10` as a half-precision floating-point number.

```javascript
var bool = ( FLOAT16_LN10 === 2.302734375 );
// returns true
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->
